data.description:
## Observation
Dependabot Updates run 41918750684 (weekly uv version update, 2026-11-04 13:43 PST), the first uv run after the uv floor landed (e0ab18822c6), ran uv 0.13.5 with no tool_version_not_supported error, built 25 dependency changes in group 'uv-lock', then `POST /update_jobs/1681618238/create_pull_request` returned 400: 'The request contains invalid or unauthorized changes' (recorded as dependency_file_not_supported). No pull request was opened. The log does not name the files in the rejected payload. Earlier uv runs never reached this step: uv refused the exact pin before any update ran.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Root cause of the 400 identified from evidence (which file or change Dependabot's API rejected), before any fix.
- [ ] A later Dependabot uv run opens the uv-lock group pull request or records no create_pull_request error.
data.title: Dependabot uv-lock group PR creation rejected with 400 'invalid or unauthorized changes'
